notes.title: 2024 RECAP
notes.notes:
2024 RECAP

With 2024 coming to a conclusion, I'd like to take a moment to update
everyone of how it went for the Studio.

Three games were released.
Raey
White Bridge
Castle Dark

White Bridge was an incredibly ambitious game for the studio and I was
thrilled to see it received by everyone so well.
This was the style of game I had wanted to create for years and finally
decided it was time to make it happen.

Castle Dark embodies another concept I've always wanted to make which is
an action RPG with crafting and trade skill elements. 
The majority of 2024 was spent making games out of the ordinary for 
Wolfs Moon Studios but you've all stuck with me for it and for that
I am truly thankful.

Stay tuned for 2025.

Wolfs Moon Studios
